<strong data-start="288" data-end="328">8 out of 10 great wind days per tour</strong>, there’s been an incredible amount of time on the water, backed up by <strong data-start="399" data-end="454">daily clinics, demos and loads of personal coaching</strong> from some of Australia’s top riders, including <strong data-start="502" data-end="566">Chris Sal — one Australia’s highest-qualified instructors</strong> — and the KR team.</p><p data-start="587" data-end="629">But it’s about much more than just riding.</p><p data-start="631" data-end="842">Think <strong data-start="637" data-end="791">swimming with Humpback Whales, snorkelling with Giant Trevally, local fire dancing, visiting the local primary school, island adventures, epic parties</strong> and plenty of unforgettable moments along the way.</p><p data-start="844" data-end="1012">It’s the combination of <strong data-start="868" data-end="962">world-class riding, serious progression, incredible island experiences and an awesome crew</strong> that makes the Aitutaki Winter Escape so special.</p><p data-start="1014" data-end="1107">🔥 <strong data-start="1017" data-end="1107">And with previous tours often BOOKED OUT 9 MONTHS IN ADVANCE, don’t leave it too late!</strong></p><p data-start="1109" data-end="1243" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""><strong data-start="1109" data-end="1237">Get involved, lock in your spot and come experience one of the most epic kiteboarding &amp; wingfoiling adventures going around.</strong> 🤙🏝️</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
		</div>

			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-788b022 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="788b022" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="g9ns4u" data-start="0" data-end="37"><span role="text"><strong data-start="4" data-end="37">THE AITUTAKI EXPERIENCE 🏝️🪁</strong></span></h3><p data-start="39" data-end="254">Visiting Aitutaki should be on everyone’s <strong data-start="81" data-end="97">must-do list</strong>. The incredible turquoise lagoon, white-sand motus, genuinely friendly locals and timeless island culture make it one of the most beautiful places on earth.</p><p data-start="256" data-end="366">Add <strong data-start="260" data-end="308">EPIC kiteboarding and wingfoiling conditions</strong>, and you’ve got one seriously special holiday experience.</p><p data-start="368" data-end="654">The <strong data-start="372" data-end="394">Kite Republic team</strong>, together with our local friends at <strong data-start="431" data-end="454">Wet’n’Wild Aitutaki</strong>, will look after you throughout your stay. We’ll coordinate daily trips to the outer kite spots, downwinders, beach lunches, cultural experiences, traditional <strong data-start="614" data-end="621">Umu</strong> and plenty of island adventures.</p><p data-start="656" data-end="773">And if the moon and conditions are right… <strong data-start="698" data-end="767">an overnight stay on Honeymoon Island could even be on the cards!</strong> 🌙🏝️</p><h3 data-section-id="1a2kxxm" data-start="775" data-end="814"><span role="text"><strong data-start="779" data-end="814">PROGRESS, PLAY &amp; HAVE A BALL 🤙</strong></span></h3><p data-start="816" data-end="1017">With a maximum of <strong data-start="834" data-end="847">18 people</strong>, the group stays small, social and supportive. You’ll have plenty of opportunity to push yourself, learn from other riders and make some great new friends along the way.</p><p data-start="1019" data-end="1268">There will be <strong data-start="1033" data-end="1062">daily kite &amp; wing clinics</strong>, on-water coaching and constant support throughout the trip. From beginner fundamentals to advanced tricks, tips, technique and demos, you’ll head home with a stack of new skills and plenty of inspiration.</p><h3 data-section-id="wyfsi9" data-start="1270" data-end="1315"><span role="text"><strong data-start="1274" data-end="1315">NOT A KITER OR WINGER? NO PROBLEM! ❤️</strong></span></h3><p data-start="1317" data-end="1360">Bringing a non-sailing partner? Absolutely!</p><p data-start="1362" data-end="1562">There’s an incredible amount to see and do away from the kite spots, with <strong data-start="1436" data-end="1562">island adventures, snorkelling, swimming, fishing, sightseeing, beach days and plenty of time to simply relax in paradise.</strong></p><p data-start="1564" data-end="1647" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">You might even get used to hearing a <em data-start="1601" data-end="1609">little</em> bit of kite chatter along the way… 😂</p>								</div>
				</div>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Don&#8217;t miss out on these jampacked 13 days (+ Travel), full of adventure, fun, and most importantly, kiteboarding &amp; winging so you can take your skills to the next level and come fully prepared for the Aussie summer&#8230;</p>								</div>

				<section class="elementor-section elementor-top-section elementor-element elementor-element-c3d1fa1 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default" data-id="c3d1fa1" data-element_type="section" data-e-type="section">
						<div class="elementor-container elementor-column-gap-default">
					<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-7f068a9" data-id="7f068a9" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-2234f00 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="2234f00" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="lf0l66" data-start="0" data-end="37"><span role="text">FLIGHTS &amp; TRAVEL INSURANCE ✈️</span></h3><p data-start="39" data-end="94"><strong data-start="39" data-end="94">Melbourne → Rarotonga return + Rarotonga → Aitutaki</strong></p><p data-start="96" data-end="220">Flights are booked independently and are approximately <strong data-start="151" data-end="175">$2,000–$2,500 return</strong>, depending on availability and booking time.</p><p data-start="222" data-end="422">We’ve structured the tour around the <strong data-start="259" data-end="289">best weekly flight options</strong>, and recommend booking the same or similar flights as the group to make organised transfers and accommodation as smooth as possible.</p><p data-start="424" data-end="573">Flight details are available on request. We can be flexible with your travel arrangements, so <strong data-start="518" data-end="572">get in touch if you’d like to discuss your options</strong>.</p><h3 data-section-id="ly9d93" data-start="575" data-end="603"><span role="text">TRAVEL INSURANCE 🛡️</span></h3><p data-start="605" data-end="767">We strongly recommend taking out <strong data-start="638" data-end="687">travel insurance as soon as you book the tour</strong> to protect you against unexpected cancellations, changes or travel disruptions.</p><p style="text-align: center"> </p><p data-start="769" data-end="931" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""><strong data-start="769" data-end="783">Important:</strong> Make sure your policy specifically covers <strong data-start="826" data-end="861">kiteboarding and/or wingfoiling</strong>, as many standard travel insurance policies exclude these activities.</p><p style="text-align: center"> </p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
		</div>
				<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-0b729c2" data-id="0b729c2" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-46030a9 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="46030a9" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p style="text-align: center"><span style="color: #222222;font-size: 24px;font-weight: 600;letter-spacing: 0px">VISAS &amp; ENTRY REQUIREMENTS 🛂</span></p><p data-start="39" data-end="123">Australian citizens <strong data-start="59" data-end="84">do not require a visa</strong> to enter the Cook Islands for tourism.</p><p data-start="125" data-end="322">Please ensure your passport is valid for <strong data-start="166" data-end="207">at least 6 months from your tour date</strong>, and check the entry requirements for your specific nationality if you’re travelling on a non-Australian passport.</p><p data-start="324" data-end="525" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">For the latest <strong data-start="339" data-end="378">entry, visa and health requirements</strong>, please check the official Cook Islands travel information before you travel: <a href="https://cookislands.travel/entry" target="_new" rel="noopener" data-start="457" data-end="524">Cook Islands Entry Requirements</a>.</p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
		</div>
					</div>
		</section>

				<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-top-column elementor-element elementor-element-d6274f8" data-id="d6274f8" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column">
			<div class="elementor-widget-wrap elementor-element-populated">
						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-a4e0426 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="a4e0426" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="zxf3ba" data-start="116" data-end="154"><span role="text"><strong data-start="120" data-end="154">THE LOCATION &amp; WHAT TO TAKE 🌴</strong></span></h3><p data-start="156" data-end="388">Aitutaki is an incredible playground for kiteboarding and wingfoiling, with <strong data-start="232" data-end="300">three main kite spots catering to virtually every wind direction</strong>. The water is warm, the wind is generally consistent, and <strong data-start="359" data-end="388">you won’t need a wetsuit!</strong></p><p data-start="390" data-end="495">Trade winds typically run in cycles of <strong data-start="429" data-end="441">5–8 days</strong>, with conditions ranging from around <strong data-start="479" data-end="494">10–25 knots</strong>.</p><h3 data-section-id="1yfheyg" data-start="497" data-end="521"><span role="text"><strong data-start="501" data-end="521">WHAT TO BRING 🪁</strong></span></h3><p data-start="523" data-end="545">We recommend bringing:</p><ul data-start="547" data-end="810"><li data-section-id="138l7ae" data-start="547" data-end="592"><strong data-start="549" data-end="568">2 x Kites/Wings</strong> to cover the conditions</li><li data-section-id="1qs4ufc" data-start="593" data-end="611"><strong data-start="595" data-end="611">1 x Twin Tip</strong></li><li data-section-id="j57mew" data-start="612" data-end="621">Harness</li><li data-section-id="orqj6p" data-start="622" data-end="631">Booties</li><li data-section-id="16qg8k3" data-start="632" data-end="645">Boardshorts</li><li data-section-id="1j49lbk" data-start="646" data-end="652">Pump</li><li data-section-id="1g8fu07" data-start="653" data-end="673">Long-sleeve rashie</li><li data-section-id="10pl9xo" data-start="674" data-end="685">Sunscreen</li><li data-section-id="1o43px" data-start="686" data-end="691">Hat</li><li data-section-id="otopde" data-start="692" data-end="713">Basic first aid kit</li><li data-section-id="1913gm2" data-start="714" data-end="758">Some clothes for <strong data-start="733" data-end="753">hitting the town</strong> 🌴🍹</li><li data-section-id="jo2sp5" data-start="759" data-end="810"><strong data-start="761" data-end="810">Foilers — definitely bring your foil &amp; board!</strong></li></ul><p data-start="812" data-end="927">You are solely responsible for your own <strong data-start="852" data-end="894">medical, accident and travel insurance</strong>, including any associated costs.</p><p data-start="929" data-end="1133">There is a hospital on Aitutaki with basic medical facilities, but <strong data-start="996" data-end="1043">no X-ray or major emergency care facilities</strong>. More serious injuries or medical issues may require evacuation to Rarotonga or Auckland.</p><p data-start="1135" data-end="1346">💧 <strong data-start="1138" data-end="1174">Help us keep Aitutaki beautiful:</strong> Bring an empty reusable water bottle and refill it during the trip rather than adding unnecessary plastic waste. Bottled and treated water is also available on the island.</p><h3 data-section-id="1xxacg" data-start="1348" data-end="1377"><span role="text"><strong data-start="1352" data-end="1377">PRE-TOUR INFO SESSION</strong></span></h3><p data-start="1379" data-end="1530">We’ll run an organised information session before the tour where we’ll cover everything you need to know, answer questions and get everyone tour-ready.</p><p data-start="1532" data-end="1607">Not based in Melbourne? <strong data-start="1556" data-end="1607">No worries — you can join the session via Zoom.</strong></p><hr data-start="1609" data-end="1612" /><h3 data-section-id="1shjn29" data-start="1614" data-end="1662"><span role="text"><strong data-start="1618" data-end="1662">OTHER ACTIVITIES &amp; ISLAND ADVENTURES 🏝️</strong></span></h3><p data-start="1664" data-end="1725">There’s plenty to do when you’re not on the water, including:</p><p data-start="1727" data-end="1968">🐋 Swimming with whales<br data-start="1750" data-end="1753" />🎣 Deep-sea fishing<br data-start="1772" data-end="1775" />🔥 Beach BBQ / Umu<br data-start="1793" data-end="1796" />💃 Island dance shows<br data-start="1817" data-end="1820" />🤿 Snorkelling &amp; scuba diving<br data-start="1849" data-end="1852" />🎯 Spearfishing<br data-start="1867" data-end="1870" />🏄 Wakeboarding<br data-start="1885" data-end="1888" />🌴 Island adventures &amp; sightseeing<br data-start="1922" data-end="1925" />🌊 Exploring the lagoon<br data-start="1948" data-end="1951" />…and plenty more!</p><p data-start="1970" data-end="2081" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">Or simply <strong data-start="1980" data-end="2078">hang out with a bunch of awesome people who are as stoked about kiting and winging as you are.</strong> 🤙</p><p style="text-align: center"><strong> </strong></p>								</div>
				</div>
					</div>
		</div>
					</div>
		</section>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h3 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1c3prtx" data-start="0" data-end="33"><span role="text"><strong data-start="4" data-end="33">WHAT THE KITERS SAY&#8230; 🤙</strong></span></h3><p data-start="35" data-end="181"><em data-start="35" data-end="161">“Thanks guys! The trip was truly amazing and so well organised. We were very impressed, and the coaching was fantastic too.”</em><br data-start="161" data-end="164" /><strong data-start="164" data-end="181">— Lily &amp; Fred</strong></p><p data-start="183" data-end="381"><em data-start="183" data-end="365">“I loved my trip to Aitutaki with Kite Republic. Amazing coaching and a super fun social scene, all set against the most beautiful tropical backdrop. What more could you ask for!?”</em><br data-start="365" data-end="368" /><strong data-start="368" data-end="381">— Shevy H</strong></p><p data-start="383" data-end="506"><em data-start="383" data-end="491">“Great trip with an awesome crew.
